title: The fixed ordinary open/scalar cochain comparison is conjugate to the restriction comparison.
statement: Let A and B be arbitrary commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism, and j:U→X an open immersion of schemes. For the ordinary open and scalar adjunctions of lem-coef-etale-open-comparison-data, apply mapHomologicalComplex to each and form their two composites. Conjugation of the cochain comparison induced by openScalarExtensionZero φ j under these two composite cochain adjunctions equals the cochain map induced by openRestrictScalarsIso φ j.

source.place: Proof step 2: ordinary q-zero and the right restriction/scalar square. Stacks 0E8I, 03DI, 03EK and 06YY.

proof.text: The definition of the ordinary q-zero comparison is uniqueness of left adjoints after identifying the right adjoints by the ordinary restriction square. Expanding leftAdjointUniq and conjugateEquiv_symm_apply_app identifies its conjugate with the restriction-square hom.

The unit and counit of each cochain adjunction are their ordinary unit and counit degree by degree. Evaluate the conjugate of the cochain comparison on a complex in each degree, expand the composite units and counits, and apply the ordinary identity from the first step. Equality of cochain morphisms and then natural transformations gives the claim.

theorem etaleOpenScalarCochainConjugate
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    conjugateEquiv
      (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction φ U).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).comp
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))
      (((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).comp
          ((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalarsAdjunction φ X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))
      (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (openScalarExtensionZero φ j) (.up ℤ)).hom =
    (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (openRestrictScalarsIso φ j) (.up ℤ)).hom
